name: Simulator DecisionRequest operational state
purpose: Read-only operational state shown to an external decider (baseline policy, Scheduler or human) when a machine becomes available, bound to one world and one state revision.
authority_level: Simulation operational state read model only; no command, approval or execution authority
security_classification: Internal simulation operational state; SIMULATION provenance; no credentials and no evaluator-only (Oracle) field

semantics.identity: world_id, request_id and state_revision are opaque and compared unchanged.
semantics.world: world_id is explicit; a decision answering this request must name the same world and base_state_revision.
semantics.provenance: Every document is simulator output labelled SIMULATION and is never real factory data.
semantics.exposure: Positive allow-list: only listed fields are exposed; held, not-ready and ineligible lots are never offered; a field that names evaluator-only truth is rejected.
semantics.completeness: Offline interface slice: candidates come from a FacilityPort. The operational model of WP-SIM-003 is not part of this contract.
